summary: Iteration 3 — verified mobile-incompatibility fixes (auth-callback Platform-aware redirect, admin/users native Alert delete, admin/withdrawals + admin/campaign-completions PromptModal). Backend: 35/35 pytest (100%) covering banners, campaigns, device-login, /auth/me, checkin (15..45), spin/scratch (50..100) + claim, watch (20..50, 20/day cap), admin-login promotion, all admin endpoints, withdraw flow + total_withdrawn, admin user adjust-points, admin campaign-completion approve/reject, link_url, telegram_contact, DAU stats. Frontend smoke: /login → Continue creates anonymous user via /api/auth/device and routes to /home which renders banners + 5 seeded campaigns (PhonePe/Groww/Dream11/Cred/MX Player). grep confirms ZERO references to window.confirm/window.prompt/window.location in /app/frontend/app or /app/frontend/src (only comments mentioning them remain). PromptModal renders testID='prompt-modal' with prompt-input/prompt-cancel/prompt-confirm.

ui_bugs.issue: router.replace('/login') is called inside the very first useEffect tick, which on web throws the Expo-router warning 'Attempted to navigate before mounting the Root Layout component'. Page does not crash (Expo retries the nav and eventually lands on /login) but a noisy console error is logged twice. Wrap the redirect in a 0ms setTimeout / requestAnimationFrame, or move it inside useFocusEffect, so it fires after Root Layout mounts.

Bottom tab buttons do NOT carry testID props (tab-home / tab-earn / tab-wallet / tab-profile). Tabs render and are visually tappable, but cannot be selected by automated tests. Add tabBarButtonTestID or testID to each Tabs.Screen options.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): Defer router.replace in auth-callback.tsx until after the root layout mounts (setTimeout 0 or useFocusEffect) to silence the 'Attempted to navigate before mounting Root Layout' warning on web.
OPTIONAL (LOW): Add testID props to bottom tabs in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (tab-home / tab-earn / tab-wallet / tab-profile) so automation can drive tab navigation.
No code-level fixes needed for the 4 mobile-blocker bugs — they are all properly resolved (verified by grep + file inspection).
critical_code_review_comments: auth-callback.tsx: Platform.OS check is good but both branches do the same router.replace('/login'); the if-block is essentially dead code and could be collapsed.
PromptModal.tsx: clean cross-platform impl with KeyboardAvoidingView + Modal + autoFocus + multiline; testIDs prompt-modal/prompt-input/prompt-cancel/prompt-confirm all present.
admin/users.tsx delete uses Alert.alert with destructive style cancel/delete — native-compatible (no window.confirm).
admin/withdrawals.tsx and admin/campaign-completions.tsx use PromptModal for reject/reset reasons with 'Reason required' Alert when empty — fully mobile-safe.
Backend test conftest had a hardcoded fallback URL pointing to a different project (taskwheel-preview); fixed to read EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env via dotenv_values.
Backend test file had stale assumptions (POST /tasks/campaign/{id} no longer creates a completion — that's now /tasks/campaign/{id}/submit). Tests updated to match current API contract.

rca_of_issue: Mobile crash RCA: React Native polyfills `window` as `{}` but does NOT polyfill window.confirm / window.prompt / window.location. The original imported code from GitHub called these directly, which throws TypeError on iOS/Android. Resolution applied by main agent: (1) auth-callback.tsx replaced window.location.hash parsing with a Platform-aware no-op redirect to /login; (2) admin/users delete replaced window.confirm() with React Native's Alert.alert() destructive dialog; (3) admin/withdrawals + admin/campaign-completions replaced window.prompt() with the new cross-platform PromptModal (Modal + TextInput). All four are verified resolved — `grep -rE 'window\.(confirm|prompt|location)' /app/frontend/app /app/frontend/src` returns only comments, never call-sites.
